subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for native chat lifecycle

question: Should the tray publish this chat lifecycle signal catalog now, with gateway trace propagation explicitly deferred?
rationale: The patch creates a new supported observability surface whose signal names, lifecycle semantics, and process boundary are product and operations choices rather than mechanically provable implementation details.

options.title: Approve after refreshed proof
options.body: Accept the proposed signal contract once current-head collector evidence demonstrates direct and queued chat turns without sensitive attributes.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Ship only the core turn, send, and response signals now and defer history, backfill, and queue metrics until their operational value is established.

options.title: Coordinate gateway propagation first
options.body: Defer the tray telemetry contract until the gateway protocol can propagate trace context and produce one end-to-end trace.

recommendation.title: Approve after refreshed proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed signal contract once current-head collector evidence demonstrates direct and queued chat turns without sensitive attributes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared telemetry policy, tray behavior, and the gateway tracing boundary rather than only one chat implementation detail.
